FN-0IZN6G-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 220
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Corley Ellis
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/20/2023
House Bill 220 as introduced would increase the salary expenses of the Shelby County Board of
Registrars, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated maximum of $13,700 annually.
The provisions of this act could also increase the mileage, travel, and other expenses reimbursed
to the Board from the State General Fund, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the
number of additional meeting days and the number of members in attendance.
